data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open hotel search, type and pick a destination, pick dates, set rooms and guests, search, filter, sort by price low to high) with the right parameters, but it adds children, child ages and several filter types that weren't in the real run and puts the sort step after the filters, so it is more detailed than the true workflow while still being concrete enough to automate.
